newsitem.title: EU: Reuter EC Report Long-Term Diary for June 16-Dec 31, 1997 (page 1/4 - June 16-30).
newsitem.headline: Reuter EC Report Long-Term Diary for June 16-Dec 31, 1997 (page 1/4 - June 16-30).

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
AMSTERDAM - The Netherlands hosts summit of European Union leaders (June 16-17).
MADRID - NATO holds summit to set the course for enlargement (July 8 and 9).
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg hosts summit of European Union leaders (December 12-13).
MONDAY, JUNE 16
LUXEMBOURG (MODIFIED ITEM) - EU fisheries ministers meeting HAS BEEN CANCELLED.

AMSTERDAM - Dutch presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (to June 17). The leaders aim to complete an inter-governmental conference on EU treaty reforms, including institutional reforms such as the size of the European Commission and voting procedures, immigration and asylum policy, employment and the Social Chapter, a common foreign and security policy and "flexibility" - the possibility for some members to forge deeper ties, with more reluctant partners free to catch up when they want to. Other agenda items include presentation of a report on organised crime, legal framework for introducing the euro single currency, European Commission action plan and timetable for removing remaining internal trade barriers by the time the euro is introduced.
TUESDAY, JUNE 17

LUXEMBOURG - EU transport ministers meet (To June 18). Provisional agenda includes air transport noise, air transport negotiations with the United States and Central and East European countries, EU membership in the European Organisation for the Safety of Air Navigation, proposed European organisation responsible for civil aviation safety, charges on heavy goods vehicles, seafarer training, sea passenger registration, transport negotiations with Switzerland.

BRUSSELS - European Food Law sixth annual conference (To June 18). Main issues discussed are food safety, genetically modified foods and food law. Speakers include: Head of Commission Directorate-General XXIV (Consumer Policy) Horst Reichenbach. Venue: Radisson Hotel. Contact: IBC (44) 1892 511 807.
